title: Access control and checking in 5GMM-IDLE mode and in 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication

entities.name: UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where it is registered but has no active NAS signaling connection. Includes both 5GMM-IDLE mode and 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.

entities.name: Access attempt
entities.description: Procedure initiated when UE receives request from upper layers for network access while in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: Access category
entities.description: Classification of access attempt type determined by NAS based on tables 4.5.2.1/4.5.2.2 or 4.5.2A.1/4.5.2A.2.

entities.name: Access identities
entities.description: Identifiers assigned to the access attempt for access control purposes.

entities.name: RRC establishment cause
entities.description: Cause value provided to lower layers for RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: Initial NAS message
entities.description: First NAS message sent for an access attempt, such as REGISTRATION REQUEST, SERVICE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: Uplink data status IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates PDU sessions with pending uplink user data.

entities.name: Access barring check
entities.description: Check performed by lower layers to determine if access attempt is allowed or barred.

entities.name: Barring timers
entities.description: Timers run by lower layers on per access category basis to control access barring duration.

entities.name: Barring alleviation
entities.description: Condition where access barring is lifted for a specific access category.

relations.description: Access attempt procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.
Access attempt procedure establishes access category classification.
Access attempt procedure establishes access identities.
Access attempt procedure may establish RRC establishment cause.
Initial NAS message contains Uplink data status IE when UE has uplink user data pending.
Access barring check condition guards whether access attempt procedure proceeds.
Barring timers establish barring alleviation condition upon expiry.
Barring alleviation condition guards whether access attempt can be initiated.
